news.title: Wonder Cement & Dalmia Bharat's limestone mining projects near Rajasthan's Great Indian Bustard 'priority area' approved
news.para: Rajasthan's Jaisalmer region has given the green light to two limestone mining initiatives that encounter the habitats of the Great Indian Bustard. One project intrudes on a designated priority area, while the other lies a kilometer away. Despite concerns over the longevity of endangered species conservation, these projects were approved, with environmental assessments indicating minor impacts and the need for ongoing monitoring and protective measures.

news.title: Lucknow development body plans levy charge to fund pending works in Sushant Golf City
news.para: In Sushant Golf City, property owners may face a new completion charge tied to building approvals. This fee is intended to support ongoing infrastructure projects, covering crucial developments like roadways and sewage systems. However, plot holders of EWS and LIG with smaller plots will be exempt, benefitting more than 10,000 allottees. The Lucknow Development Authority aims to enhance the completion procedure to better manage the township's future.

news.title: Property fraud cases rise in South Goa despite SIT probe
news.para: South Goa is witnessing a surge in land-grab activities and property fraud. The police have taken action by registering several FIRs against these criminal acts. Notably, one complaint revolves around false claims of land ownership and suspicious contracts between involved parties. Additionally, there’s a case of property being improperly used as collateral for a hefty bank loan.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh: UPEIDA launches industrial plot scheme in eight clusters
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority (UPEIDA) is rolling out a new initiative to distribute industrial plots within eight Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Clusters located in cities such as Meerut and Hardoi. The land premiums vary between Rs 3,800 and Rs 11,470 per square metre, and interested businesses can apply online via the Nivesh Mitra platform. This scheme is designed to improve connectivity and attract investment to the region.

news.title: Mhada seeks FIR against 23 developers for violating inclusive housing norms, police yet to initiate process
news.para: Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority has taken a stand against 23 developers who allegedly defaulted on transferring land designated for affordable housing. This failure reportedly violates inclusive housing laws, raising significant regulatory concerns. While Mhada has called upon the police for intervention, action remains pending, with the next steps hinging on further discussions between Mhada and police officials.

news.title: Haryana RERA directs Ocean Seven to pay delay interest to 12 Expressway Towers allottees in Gurugram
news.para: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has mandated that Ocean Seven Buildtech compensates homebuyers with interest following their failure to deliver flats at Expressway Towers on time. The interest, set at an annual rate of 10.8% based on the State Bank of India's rates, must be paid within 90 days.

news.title: Flat furnishing not as promised, Mahagun developer told to refund buyer ₹2 lakh
news.para: District consumer commission has mandated Dhanya Promoters to refund ₹2 lakh to a homebuyer due to unmet promises. Vaidhi Sharma filed a complaint after the firm failed to deliver the promised flat and amenities. Despite an agreement that included various free services, many were not provided at the time of possession. The commission found ample evidence supporting Sharma's claims against the promoters' inaction and negligence.

news.title: Home registrations in Kolkata dip 12% in January-September 2026: Report
news.para: Kolkata Metropolitan Area saw a 12 percent decrease in home registrations compared to the previous year. Mid-sized apartments, measuring 501-1,000 sq ft, represented 58 percent of total registrations. Conversely, smaller apartments under 500 sq ft experienced a 42 percent decline. North Kolkata led registrations, with Rajarhat recording the highest individual location figures. This shift highlights a growing preference for more spacious and functional homes amid overall reduced market activity.

news.title: China Evergrande liquidators recover 1% of debt claims after 2.5 years
news.para: The liquidators of China Evergrande Group have successfully retrieved $435.9 million via asset sales and loan recoveries. They project that the first interim dividend payment for creditors will occur in the first half of 2027. With approximately $46 billion in creditor claims and ongoing defaults, the liquidators face daunting challenges, particularly in recovering assets from the developer's mainland subsidiaries, a process expected to extend over a decade.

news.title: Orient Cement's net profit slips 34.7% to ₹32 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Orient Cement Ltd reported a significant year-on-year decline of 34.7 percent in net profit for the September quarter. A 12.13 percent dip in revenue from operations compared to the previous year contributed to a total income decrease of 11.75 percent, despite total expenses decreasing by 8 percent. In a strategic move under the Adani Group, the company is merging with Ambuja Cements.

news.title: Sonu Sood leases commercial property in Mumbai for five years; rent outlay at ₹3.52 crore
news.para: Actor Sonu Sood has leased out a commercial unit in Versova, Andheri West, Mumbai, for five years, with the aggregate rent over the tenure estimated at about ₹3.52 crore. The transaction was registered in October 2026, according to Square Yards.

news.title: Mahindra Lifespace Developers’ net profit declines 66% to ₹16.34 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Mahindra Lifespace Developers reported a significant decline of 65.9 percent in net consolidated profit for the second quarter. However, total income surged to ₹104.02 crore, with residential pre-sales booming by 41 percent. The first half of FY27 saw total income soar to ₹1,081.56 crore compared to ₹73.67 crore the previous year.

news.title: State government reconstitutes Tamil Nadu Real Estate Regulatory Authority
news.para: The Tamil Nadu government has recently restructured its Real Estate Regulatory Authority, appointing retired IAS officer K Phanindra Reddy as the chairperson. This new team, composed of various retired bureaucrats and judges, emerges after a six-month supersession of the authority. The decisions were informed by a selection committee's recommendations set up by the government, showcasing a commitment to effective real estate governance.

news.title: Goa: GSUDA to appoint agency to audit property tax survey
news.para: Goa State Urban Development Agency plans to hire a third-party agency to audit its GIS-based property tax survey. The agency will verify the accuracy of the municipal revenue mapping across various localities. This independent audit is aimed at ensuring reliability, which is essential for future property tax assessments. The audit will encompass data validation and sample field checks to identify discrepancies.

news.title: Despite slower property sales, Telangana's registration revenue surges to ₹8,700 crore
news.para: Telangana's property registration revenue has surged, resulting in an additional Rs 1,500 crore compared to last year. The revenue growth occurs amid a decline in agricultural land registrations due to rising prices impacting demand. Overall, government land value revisions have driven higher revenue despite a slowdown in certain segments. Officials anticipate improved property activity in the upcoming months as traditionally crucial registration periods approach.

news.title: SC upholds Shree Naman Developers' acquisition of Bengaluru, Pune hotel under NCLT proceedings
news.para: The Supreme Court has upheld insolvency proceedings against Gstaad Hotels and Neo Capricorn Plaza. This decision arises while clarifying that disputes over outstanding debt do not prevent corporate insolvency resolution. The National Company Law Tribunal approved resolution plans exceeding the companies' admitted liabilities. Challenges to these proceedings were rejected, emphasizing that historical defaults occurred despite arguments on financial management. The ruling maintains the legality of the insolvency process moving forward.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh government simplifies occupancy certificate process, automates approvals for buildings
news.para: Andhra Pradesh has introduced an automated system for issuing Occupancy Certificates to streamline the process. Applicants now submit necessary details online through the Development Permission Management System portal. The new method reduces the need for physical inspections and multiple visits to government offices. Mortgage release letters and related documents will be automatically generated along with the certificates.

news.title: Relief for home buyers as Karnataka-RERA takes firm stand on pre-handover charges
news.para: The Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority has made a landmark decision, stating builders cannot transfer certain costs to buyers. This directive seeks to minimize disputes over unexpected charges before property possession. Buyers will enjoy clearer insights into their financial responsibilities for new flats. Additionally, developers are urged to be transparent about cost disclosures.

news.title: In relief for Avinash Bhosale, Bombay HC says ₹25 crore received by his firm ABIL not proceeds of crime
news.para: The Bombay High Court delivered a significant verdict in favor of builder Avinash Bhosale, ruling that the Rs 25 crore he received in 2019 is not indicative of crime as suggested by the Enforcement Directorate. The court annulled the provisional seizure of properties associated with Bhosale, affirming the legality of his company's financial transactions while drawing a clear line between lawful business and suspected money laundering.

news.title: Five-storey buildings on small plots flout stilt+four floor rules in Gurugram
news.para: In Sushant Lok-1, construction work on EWS plots is not adhering to building regulations and development standards. Many buildings have surpassed their approved height and changed designated parking zones into residential areas, putting additional stress on community infrastructure. Local officials are set to act against these infractions to ensure compliance.
